name: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet): annual prices for crude oil, natural gas, wheat and soybeans
source: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet), CMO Historical Data - Annual, sheet 'Annual Prices (Nominal)'
license: CC BY 4.0, attribution required (World Bank Commodity Markets / Pink Sheet)
unit: mixed per column: crude oil USD/bbl; natural gas USD/mmbtu; wheat USD/mt; soybeans USD/mt (nominal US dollars)
coverage: 2015-2024 (10 annual rows); 4 series x 10 years = 40 values; source workbook annual table updated 2025-01-03 and ends at 2024 (no 2025 annual value in the file)

natural_gas_us_usd_per_mmbtu.unit: USD per million British thermal units

notes: Compact 10-year annual pin of four Pink Sheet series (4 columns + year): values copied from the official annual nominal workbook cells as stored, no rounding, averaging or recomputation; LF, UTF-8 without BOM. The raw 3,132,896 B xlsx is NOT committed. Annual averages are not daily spot prices and not futures settlements; no monthly Pink Sheet history, no forecast, no PIT/vintage archive is included (the workbook is a dated snapshot, updated 2025-01-03). World Bank Commodity Markets data are CC BY 4.0 with attribution; terms page was not retrieved (HTTP 404 from the World Bank URL tried - the CC BY 4.0 licence URL is the operative licence reference). Attribution: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet), https://www.worldbank.org/en/research/commodity-markets, retrieved 2026-11-26. See docs/251.
